title: 1. What does BALI FRUITS deliver?
html: BALI FRUITS delivers fresh fruits, vegetables, herbs and curated produce selections from local Bali growers to homes, villas and businesses across Bali.

title: 2. Do you deliver only fruits?
html: No. Even if the brand name is BALI FRUITS, the service also includes vegetables, leafy greens, herbs, smoothie-friendly produce and seasonal harvest boxes.

title: 3. Where do you deliver in Bali?
html: Delivery is organized by service zones across Bali. Main areas may include Canggu, Berawa, Pererenan, Seminyak, Kuta, Sanur, Denpasar, Ubud, Jimbaran, Uluwatu, Nusa Dua and selected surrounding areas.

title: 4. How are delivery zones calculated?
html: Delivery zones are based on the customer address, distance, daily route and delivery availability. The final zone is confirmed after we check the address details.

title: 5. Is it next-day delivery?
html:
Yes. BALI FRUITS offers next-day delivery as our standard service. We may also accept urgent deliveries, depending on product availability, delivery zone and daily route capacity.

For urgent delivery confirmation, please send us a message on WhatsApp.

title: 6. Is delivery available every day?
html: Delivery availability depends on your zone and daily route planning. We confirm availability after receiving your address and order details.

title: 7. Can I order for same-day or urgent delivery?
html:
Yes, urgent deliveries may be available depending on produce availability, your delivery area and the daily delivery route.

Please contact us on WhatsApp for immediate confirmation before placing an urgent order.

title: 8. What time will my order arrive?
html:
Standard deliveries are scheduled between 9:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m.

Delivery timing may vary slightly depending on your area, traffic and daily route planning.

title: 9. How much is the delivery fee?
html:
Delivery fees depend on the service zone:

  • Zone 3: free delivery
  • Zone 1 and Zone 2: fixed delivery cost of IDR 35,000
  • Zone 4 and Zone 5: fixed delivery cost of IDR 50,000

The final delivery zone is confirmed after checking the customer address.

title: 10. Is there a minimum order?
html: A minimum order may apply depending on the delivery zone. The amount is shown before checkout or confirmed before the order is finalized.

title: 11. Where do the fruits and vegetables come from?
html:
All BALI FRUITS products are locally produced in Bali and sourced from local farmers using organic and bio cultivation methods.

We do not buy from bulk importers or extensive farming producers. Our focus is local sourcing, direct grower relationships, freshness and transparent origin.

title: 12. Are all products organic?
html: Our products come from local growers using organic and bio cultivation methods. When a product has specific certification or grower information available, we indicate it clearly in the product details.

title: 13. What does source-tracked mean?
html: Source-tracked means that we aim to show where selected produce comes from, including the growing area, supplier or farmer group when available. This gives customers better visibility than ordinary supermarket supply chains.

title: 14. Are products washed before delivery?
html: Produce is checked and packed carefully. Some items may be lightly cleaned, but we recommend washing all fruits, vegetables and herbs before use.

title: 15. How is the produce packed?
html: BALI FRUITS uses simple natural packaging such as kraft boxes, paper bags, bio envelopes and branded stickers where possible. Our packaging is designed to feel clean, natural and premium.

title: 16. Can I choose individual products?
html: Yes. Customers can browse products, add fruits and vegetables to the cart, and place an order through the app or website.

title: 17. Do you offer curated boxes?
html:
Yes. BALI FRUITS offers curated selections such as:

  • Tropical Fruit Box: mango, papaya, pineapple, bananas and seasonal specials.
  • Family Produce Box: fruit, vegetables and herbs for easy weekly cooking.
  • Greens & Smoothie Box: leafy greens, avocado, citrus and smoothie-friendly fruit.

title: 18. What happens if one product is unavailable?
html: If an item is unavailable due to harvest or daily supply conditions, we will contact you with a suitable replacement or adjust the order.

title: 19. Can I request substitutions?
html: Yes. Customers can add notes such as “no bananas”, “extra avocado”, “ripe mango only”, or “replace unavailable items with leafy greens”.

title: 20. Can I choose ripe or unripe fruit?
html: Yes, where possible. Customers can request ripe, medium-ripe or less-ripe fruit in the order notes. Availability depends on daily harvest and supplier stock.

title: 21. Can I order for a villa, hotel or Airbnb?
html: Yes. BALI FRUITS is suitable for private villas, expat homes, Airbnb stays, retreat villas and small hospitality kitchens.

title: 22. Can I schedule recurring delivery?
html: Yes. Recurring weekly delivery can be arranged for selected customers, villas and households.

title: 23. Can restaurants or cafés order?
html: Yes. Restaurants, cafés, retreat kitchens and private chefs can contact BALI FRUITS for regular supply requests.

title: 24. How do I pay?
html: Available payment methods are shown at checkout or confirmed with your order.

title: 25. What if I am not home during delivery?
html: Please provide clear delivery instructions, villa name, WhatsApp number, security or gate contact, or a safe drop-off point.

title: 26. What if my produce arrives damaged?
html: Please contact us on the same day with a photo of the item. We will review the issue and offer a replacement, credit or refund when appropriate.

title: 27. Can I cancel my order?
html: Orders can be cancelled before sourcing and packing begins. Once the produce has been purchased and prepared, cancellation may no longer be possible.

title: 28. Why are some items seasonal?
html: BALI FRUITS depends on local harvest cycles. Seasonal changes affect availability, ripeness, price and quality.

title: 29. Why are prices sometimes different from supermarkets?
html: BALI FRUITS focuses on local sourcing, freshness, quality checking, natural packaging and home delivery. Prices reflect produce quality, grower availability, route cost and service handling.

title: 30. How do I contact BALI FRUITS?
html: You can contact BALI FRUITS through the website, app, WhatsApp or order confirmation channel.
